sources.player: Player review, 2026-10-20: no Spirit Vessel for offlaners against heavy healing (a support's item); Linken's Sphere for Queen of Pain, Puck, Void Spirit and Storm Spirit against Phantom Assassin and Spirit Breaker, not Slark; Axe levels Battle Hunger second; Templar Assassin keeps Meld > Psi Blades > Refraction.

rules.name: Black King Bar
rules.basis: Valve 7.41f Black King Bar: Avatar applies a basic dispel, 60% magic resistance and makes negative effects of enemy spells do nothing for 9/8/7 s. It is in his build (57% of the won games, ~25 min); Pipe of Insight is not.

reason.en: {enemy} and other magic damage heroes are in their team: {item} is in your build, take it earlier, so their spells cannot catch you between your Timber Chains
reason.uk: {enemy} та інші герої з магічною шкодою: {item} і так у вашій збірці — візьміть його раніше, щоб їхні здібності не зловили вас між Timber Chain

tempo.basis: Gold lines where the hero wins 85.0%+: 20:00 12500 (28 games, 85.7%), 25:00 17000 (30 games, 86.7%), 30:00 21500 (26 games, 88.5%); net worth ~0.96 of that gold; points under 20 games left out.
